claude.rationale: gap_45 = 0 because the product portfolio (fuel injection, actuators, sensors, control modules, plus Aftermarket line) crossed the boundary together with its producing/delivering operations — 20 major manufacturing facilities, 12 technical centers, and ~5,000 scientists/engineers operating in 24 countries on a regional service model — so product and its processes moved coherently at closing. gap_56 = 0 because the operational processes transferred alongside the organization/people (~5,000 personnel) and dedicated standalone management (Liam Butterworth as separate CEO of DPS), so T5 and T6 aligned at closing. T5 is coded partial (not gap-producing) because certain IT, supply-chain management functions, and up-to-48-month component supply remained with the Parent and were bridged by the Transition Services and contract manufacturing agreements — a shared-substrate friction, not a product/process or process/people detachment.

gemini.rationale: The transaction is a spin-off where the Powertrain Systems segment (T4 products) transfers to a new independent company. However, certain components will continue to be produced by the Parent and supplied to DPS, and shared corporate substrate (IT, supply chain) did not transfer intact, creating a gap_45 (product transferred but some producing operations/processes remained with Parent). This gap is mitigated by contract manufacturing services agreements and a Transition Services Agreement. The dedicated management and 5,000 employees transferred with the operations that did move, so there is no gap_56.

openai.rationale: The product portfolio crossed with major manufacturing facilities, technical centers, and technical personnel, but certain components remained produced by the Parent and shared IT and supply-chain services did not transfer intact, documenting a product-process gap at closing [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-279255, Form 10-12B EX-99.1]. That gap was contractually absorbed through transition-services and contract-manufacturing agreements, including component supply for up to 48 months [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-279255, Form 10-12B EX-99.1]. No process-organization gap is documented because the separated business included its associated employees and dedicated standalone management alongside its operations [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-17-279255, Form 10-12B EX-99.1].
